svg.aria-label: A drop falls into dark water, sending warm ripples outward. The words read: A small act. Kindness ripples. One kind thing, passed on, can travel further than you will ever see. Pass it on.
svg.title: Kindness ripples
svg.desc: A single drop falls into still, dark water. Rings of light spread far beyond the point of impact. Text: one kind thing, passed on, can travel further than you will ever see.
